verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs say `remember` ingests text, files, or URLs and builds the knowledge graph in one call. The docs index describes turning documents, code, and application data into memory, and business sources are covered by Slack, Notion, Linear, Google Drive and GitHub integrations, so ingestion clearly goes beyond chat transcripts. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of JSON or structured-data ingestion, no list of supported file formats, no independent or hands-on corroboration of non-chat ingestion.
